name: Creamy Coriander Chicken, Bell Pepper & Celery Sauté with Red Lentils
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and sauté until cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth to the skillet. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 6-7 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet, stir to combine, and simmer until heated through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cream.
To serve, divide lentils and chicken sauté between bowls. Garnish with reserved parsley and enjoy!
author: Mealime
